title: Todd Bowles took a knee on sideline late in Thursday's game after hit to stomach during celebration

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Todd Bowles took a knee on sideline late in Thursday's game after hit to stomach during celebration
sources.description: As the Buccaneers were running out the clock on Thursday night's win in Dallas, television cameras caught Bucs head coach Todd Bowles taking a knee on the sideline while grimacing in pain.
